Like other texts in this collection, it preserves the biographical account and past karmic actions of a thera, here Giripunnāgiya. SuttaCentral registers five modern translations of the text in five languages [SuttaCentral].

Within Pali literature, however, DharmaNexus records 82 text-reuse matches across 32 texts [DharmaNexus].
